extension.author: Brian Mitchell

extension.description:
This plugin provides an MCP (Management Control Program) to manage Joomla articles and categories via a secure API endpoint, using Joomla's built-in API Token for authentication.

Setup Instructions

  1. Go to System -> Manage -> Plugins and ensure the plugin named "Web Services - Authentication - Token" is enabled.
  2. Go to Users -> Manage and select a user who will have API access.
  3. In the user's profile, click the "Joomla API Token" tab.
  4. Click "Create a New Token" to generate an API key for this user. The user must have permissions to create, edit, or manage the content you wish to interact with.
  5. Use this generated token in the X-Joomla-Token header of your requests.

Usage Examples (cURL)

Replace https://www.yoursite.com with your site's URL and YOUR_JOOMLA_API_TOKEN with the token you generated.

Get All Articles

curl -X POST -H "X-Joomla-Token: YOUR_JOOMLA_API_TOKEN" "https://www.yoursite.com/index.php?task=mcp.get_articles"

Create a New Article

curl -X POST -H "X-Joomla-Token: YOUR_JOOMLA_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"title": "New Article from MCP", "articletext": "<p>This is the content.</p>", "catid": 2, "published": true}' "https://www.yoursite.com/index.php?task=mcp.create_article"

Move an Article to Trash (ID: 123)

curl -X POST -H "X-Joomla-Token: YOUR_JOOMLA_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"article_id": 123}' "https://www.yoursite.com/index.php?task=mcp.move_article_to_trash"

Update an Article (ID: 124)

curl -X POST -H "X-Joomla-Token: YOUR_JOOMLA_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"article_id": 124, "title": "Updated Title", "articletext": "<p>New updated content.</p>"}' "https://www.yoursite.com/index.php?task=mcp.update_article"

fieldset.name: content
fieldset.label: Content
fieldset.description: Select which features of the plugin should be active for management by external sources.

field.name: enable_get_article
field.label: Get Article
field.description: Retrieve a single article by its ID. Requires the article ID to be provided.

field.name: enable_get_articles
field.label: Get Articles
field.description: Retrieve a list of all articles. No additional parameters required.

field.name: enable_get_categories
field.label: Get Categories
field.description: Retrieve a list of all categories. No additional parameters required.

field.name: enable_create_article
field.label: Create Article
field.description: Create a new article with specified data. Requires title, articletext, and catid.

field.name: enable_manage_article_state
field.label: Manage Article State
field.description: Change the state of an article. Requires the article ID and target state to be provided. Possible states: 1 (published), 0 (unpublished), 2 (archived), -2 (trashed).

field.name: enable_move_article_to_trash
field.label: Move Article to Trash
field.description: Move an article to the trash. Requires the article ID to be provided.

field.name: enable_update_article
field.label: Update Article
field.description: Update an existing article with new data. Requires article ID and at least one field to update. Available fields: title, articletext, introtext, fulltext, metadesc, catid.
